result.topic_en: Euler introduces his table of divisors of numbers of the form aa+1 and begins a table of the primes of the form aa+1 together with their roots a.
result.transcription:
VALDE MAGNIS. 123
His itaque ſubſidiis hic ſubiunctam conſtruxi ta-
bulam, ex qua ſtatim pro ſingulis numeris $a$ omnes
diuiſores formae $aa+1$ habentur. Hanc quidem ta-
bulam non vltra 1500 in radicibus continuaui, ſed ope
harum formularum facile ad 2000 vsque progredi li-
cebit.
Ex hac autem tabula iam plures numeri primi
formae $aa+1$ deſumi poterunt, qui non ſolum cen-
tenis millibus, ſed etiam vno millione ſint maiores:
deinde etiam numeri primi formae $\frac{aa+1}{2}$ et $\frac{aa+1}{5}$
item $\frac{aa+1}{10}$ quos in ſequentibus tabellis exhibebo.

items.english: From this table, moreover, several prime numbers of the form aa+1 can now be taken which are greater not only than a hundred thousand but even than one million
